title: Successor formula for an equality count
statement: Let $kf:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ and $t,j\in\mathbb{N}$. The number of indices below $j+1$ at which $kf$ equals $t$ is the number below $j$, plus $1$ if $kf(j)=t$ and plus $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $kf$ is a function from natural numbers to natural numbers.
